Our method achieves 67.97% average mAP and 82.92% average nDCG on the EK-100 MIR benchmark, demonstrating the effectiveness of temporal modeling and cross-modal refinement for egocentric video retrieval.

</details>


### [146] [OmniEgo-R$^2$: A Routed Reasoning Framework for the 1st Cross-Domain EgoCross Challenge at CVPR 2026](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.24481)
*Zixu Li,Zhiwei Chen,Zhiheng Fu,Wenbo Wang,Yupeng Hu,Weili Guan,Liqiang Nie*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出OmniEgo-R²，一个统一的路由推理管线，用于解决跨域第一人称视频推理中的时间边界模糊、跨域语义粒度不匹配和近选项决策不稳定三大挑战，在EgoCross挑战赛的两个赛道中均获得第二名。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: EgoCross挑战赛评估多模态大模型在跨领域（手术、工业、极限运动、动物视角）第一人称视频上的推理能力。现有方法将这一问题简单视为多项选择VQA任务，未能充分处理跨域 embodied 视频推理的本质难点，包括时间边界模糊、跨域语义粒度差异及长多模态推理下的决策不稳定。

Method: 提出OmniEgo-R²管线，包含：(1) 时间证据归一化；(2) 域无关能力路由；(3) 结构化感知-动态-决策推理；(4) 边界感知选项验证；(5) 防御性答案校准。使用Qwen3-VL-4B-SFT作为视觉语言骨干，并包裹轻量级测试时推理与解析程序。

Result: 在Source-Limited赛道取得66.35%总体准确率，在Open-Source赛道取得66.77%总体准确率，均排名第二。

Conclusion: OmniEgo-R²通过将EgoCross重新定义为鲁棒的跨域 embodied 视频推理问题，并设计结构化的路由推理管线，有效应对了跨域视频推理的三个关键挑战，证明了多模态大模型结合轻量级测试时程序化推理在跨域第一人称视频理解中的潜力。

Abstract: The 1st Cross-Domain EgoCross Challenge at EgoVis, CVPR 2026 evaluates whether multimodal large language models can reason over egocentric videos across surgery, industry, extreme sports, and animal perspective. We achieved second place in both the Source-Limited and Open-Source tracks. In this report, we formulate EgoCross as a robust cross-domain embodied video reasoning problem rather than a simple multiple-choice visual question answering task. We identify three key challenges: (C1) temporal boundary ambiguity, where critical state transitions are sparsely sampled and often occur between frames; (C2) cross-domain semantic granularity mismatch, where the same capability requires different domain-specific visual grammar; and (C3) decision instability under close options, where long multimodal reasoning can select unsupported distractors or produce malformed outputs. To address them, we propose OmniEgo-R$^2$ (Omnidomain Egocentric Routed Reasoning), a unified routed reasoning pipeline consisting of temporal-evidence normalization, domain-agnostic capability routing, structured perception--dynamics--decision reasoning, boundary-aware option verification, and defensive answer calibration. OmniEgo-R$^2$ uses the Qwen3-VL-4B-SFT checkpoints on each EgoCross domain as the visual-language backbone, and wraps them with lightweight test-time reasoning and parsing programs. Our final submissions obtain 66.35% overall accuracy in the Source-Limited track and 66.77% in the Open-Source track, ranking second in both leaderboards. The codes are available on https://github.com/Lee-zixu/OmniEgo-R2

</details>


### [147] [EgoAction: Egocentric Action Composition with Reliability-Aware Temporal Fusion for the EPIC-KITCHENS Action Detection Challenge at CVPR 2026](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.24496)
*Zhiheng Fu,Zixu Li,Zhiwei Chen,Fangxu Liu,Yupeng Hu,Weili Guan,Liqiang Nie*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出EgoAction统一解耦检测与融合流水线，采用可靠性感知的时间融合（DWF）提升第一人称视频中动词-名词动作检测的边界定位精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 动词流和名词流在边界预测上失败模式不同（动词对运动过渡敏感，名词对手物可见性和物体杂乱敏感），固定算术均值融合会放大单一流退化时的定位误差。

Method: 1) 使用EPIC微调的VideoMAE-L特征；2) 分别训练具有因果时间建模的名词和动词时间检测器；3) 从top名词-动词对组合动作假设；4) 提出动态加权融合(DWF)，将最大名词和动词分类置信度归一化为提议级边界权重，线性组合两个区间。

Result: DWF在退化流情况下优于固定均值融合，结合滑动窗口推理、top-K名词-动词组合和类别Soft-NMS构成完整EgoAction系统。

Conclusion: EgoAction提供了一个紧凑、可复现的第一人称时序动作检测方案，核心贡献是DWF轻量级张量算子，将边界权责转移给更可靠的流。

Abstract: The EPIC-KITCHENS-100 Action Detection challenge evaluates whether a model can localize the start and end of each action in long untrimmed egocentric videos and assign the corresponding verb--noun action label. In this report, we formulate our submission as EgoAction (Egocentric Action Composition with Reliability-Aware Temporal Fusion), a unified decoupled detection and fusion pipeline. The pipeline uses EPIC-finetuned VideoMAE-L features, trains separate noun and verb temporal detectors with causal temporal modeling, composes action hypotheses from top noun--verb pairs, and introduces a confidence-adaptive boundary fusion rule at post-processing time. The key observation is that verb and noun streams often fail differently: verb scores are sensitive to motion transitions, whereas noun scores are sensitive to hand-object visibility and object clutter. A fixed arithmetic mean of their predicted boundaries can therefore amplify localization errors when one stream degenerates. We replace this hard-coded mean with Dynamic Weighted Fusion (DWF), which normalizes the maximum noun and verb classification confidences into proposal-wise boundary weights and linearly combines the two intervals. This lightweight tensor-only operator shifts boundary authority toward the more reliable stream while preserving the decoupled action scoring mechanism. Together with sliding-window inference, top-K noun--verb action composition, and class-wise Soft-NMS, EgoAction provides a compact and reproducible system for egocentric temporal action detection.

</details>


### [148] [EgoAdapt: A Multi-Scene Egocentric Adaptation Method for CVPR 2026 HD-EPIC VQA Challenge](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.24500)
*Zhiwei Chen,Yupeng Hu,Zixu Li,Zhiheng Fu,Guozhi Qiu,Weili Guan,Liqiang Nie*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: EgoAdapt是面向CVPR 2026 HD-EPIC VQA挑战赛的解决方案，通过类别条件路由、校准选项评分和测试时一致性适应三个推理时组件，解决了第一人称厨房视频问答中单一推理模板与异构时空语义结构不匹配的问题，显著超越了基线方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: HD-EPIC基准测试包含七大类（菜谱、原料、营养、细粒度动作、3D感知、物体运动、注视）共26K道多选题，主要难点不仅在于模型容量，更在于单一通用推理模板与基准中异构的时序、空间和语义结构之间的不匹配。

Method: EgoAdapt包含三个推理时组件：(1) 类别条件路由——每类别专用提示、帧预算和采样率；(2) 校准选项评分——使用字母标记似然和生成一致性评估所有候选答案，而非仅依赖直接生成；(3) 测试时一致性适应——聚合跨选项排列和验证式提示的预测结果以处理模糊情况。

Result: 该方法显著优于现有的HD-EPIC基线。

Conclusion: EgoAdapt通过针对异构任务结构设计的推理时自适应策略，有效提升了第一人称视频理解中视觉-语言模型的问答性能。

Abstract: This technical report presents our solution, EgoAdapt (Egocentric Adaptation via Category, Calibration, and Consistency), to the CVPR 2026 HD-EPIC VQA challenge. HD-EPIC evaluates whether a vision-language model can reason over realistic first-person kitchen videos, where the evidence for an answer may be a short hand-object interaction, a long recipe trajectory, a spatial relation to a fixture, or a subtle gaze cue. The benchmark contains 26K multiple-choice questions across seven macro-categories: recipe, ingredient, nutrition, fine-grained action, 3D perception, object motion, and gaze. We observe that the main difficulty is not only model capacity, but also the mismatch between a single generic inference recipe and the heterogeneous temporal, spatial, and semantic structure of the benchmark. Our method, EgoAdapt, introduces three inference-time components: (1) category-conditioned routing with per-category prompts, frame budgets, and sampling rates; (2) calibrated option scoring that evaluates all candidate answers with letter-token likelihoods and generation agreement instead of relying only on direct generation; and (3) test-time consistency adaptation that aggregates predictions across option permutations and verification-style prompts for ambiguous cases. This design substantially improves over the available HD-EPIC baselines.

</details>


### [149] [RAPTOR+: A Visually Grounded Vision-Language Framework to Improve Clinical Trust and Auditability in Automated Cancer Referral Processing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.25956)
*Sofiat Abioye,Ufaq Khan,Shazad Ashraf,Anusha Jose,Adam Byfield,Lukman Akanbi,Muhammad Bilal*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: RAPTOR+ 是一个多模态扩展系统，使用视觉-语言模型实现端到端的结直肠癌紧急转诊单理解，通过微调 Qwen3-VL-8B 在读取准确率（96.1%）和证据定位（60.6% Strict Safety）上显著优于零样本模型，实现了可审计的临床文档理解。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 紧急疑似结直肠癌转诊流程中，半结构化临床文档需要人工审查和转录，造成操作瓶颈。原有 RAPTOR 系统依赖独立的 OCR 阶段，易受手写、布局变化影响，且丢失了视觉证据的关联性。

Method: 提出 RAPTOR+ 多模态扩展，使用视觉-语言模型进行端到端转诊理解。在 223 份临床整理的 CRC 紧急转诊表单上，评估了微调 VLM、商业及开源零样本 VLM，以及原有基于 OCR 的流水线。同时引入基于接地（grounding）的评估框架，同时衡量提取准确性和证据定位能力。

Result: Gemini 2.5 Flash 零样本模型读取准确率 92.6% 但 Strict Safety 仅 1.2%；微调后的 Qwen3-VL-8B 读取准确率 96.1%，Strict Safety 达 60.6%，显著提升了可验证的证据接地能力。

Conclusion: 任务特定的微调对于实现可靠、可审计的临床文档理解至关重要。RAPTOR+ 能够将提取的转诊决策链接到视觉证据，支持更安全、更高效的癌症转诊分诊。

Abstract: Urgent suspected colorectal cancer (CRC) referrals create operational bottlenecks because semi-structured clinical documents often require manual review and transcription. The original RAPTOR system used Large Language Models for structured extraction but relied on a separate OCR stage, making it vulnerable to handwriting, layout variation, and loss of visual evidence linkage. We present RAPTOR+, a multimodal extension that uses Vision-Language Models (VLMs) for end-to-end referral understanding. We evaluate fine-tuned VLMs, commercial and open-source zero-shot VLMs, and the original OCR-based pipeline on 223 clinically curated CRC urgent referral forms. We also introduce a grounding-aware evaluation framework that measures both extraction accuracy and evidence localisation. Results show a clear grounding gap in zero-shot models. Gemini 2.5 Flash achieved 92.6% Reading Accuracy but only 1.2% Strict Safety. In contrast, fine-tuned Qwen3-VL-8B achieved 96.1% Reading Accuracy and 60.6% Strict Safety, substantially improving verifiable evidence grounding. These findings show that task-specific fine-tuning is essential for reliable, auditable clinical document understanding. RAPTOR+ enables extracted referral decisions to be linked to visual evidence, supporting safer and more efficient cancer referral triage.

</details>


### [150] [PathWISE: Multi-Agent Cancer Pathway Triaging Ontology Learning from Clinical Flowcharts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.25970)
*Sofiat Abioye,Ufaq Khan,Shazad Ashraf,Mohammed Adil Butt,Andrew D. Beggs,Adam Byfield,Anusha Jose,Junaid Qadir,Muhammad Bilal*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: PathWISE是一个五阶段流水线，结合四个LLM智能体、确定性深度优先搜索审计器和Java编译器批评者，将临床路径流程图（非可计算形式）转化为可执行HL7 CQL库，部署为FHIR CDS Hooks服务。在五项英国NHS癌症路径上验证，实现100%语法编译成功，错误节点使用假占位符保持可编译性，且无幻觉术语代码。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 临床路径以视觉流程图形式传播，其空间拓扑、箭头方向、颜色编码和字体粗细编码了关键的分诊逻辑，但这些逻辑无法被计算系统访问和处理。

Method: 五阶段流水线：(1) 专用智能体将流程图结构提取为类型化有向图；(2) 确定性路径枚举；(3) 对每个节点的可计算性进行结构化语义审计；(4) 生成受术语约束的CQL定义，并由官方Java CQL-to-ELM编译器验证；(5) 生成覆盖100%枚举患者旅程的路由逻辑。LLM推理仅用于知识提取，确定性图数学和标准编译器支撑所有验证步骤。

Result: 在五项NHS癌症路径（结直肠、肺、皮肤、上消化道、乳腺）上，PathWISE审计多达183个节点（混合配置下182个），识别544个跨四个问题类别的结构化治理发现，实现100%语法编译成功。不可计算节点使用假占位符保持可编译性，同时暴露治理差距供临床审查，且对词典覆盖的概念产生零幻觉术语代码。

Conclusion: PathWISE通过将非确定性LLM推理限制在知识提取阶段，同时使用确定性图数学和标准编译器支撑每个验证步骤，成功地将非可计算的视觉临床路径转化为可执行、已验证的计算制品。

Abstract: Clinical pathways are disseminated as visual flowcharts where spatial topology, arrow direction, colour coding, and font weight encode critical triage logic that remains inaccessible to computational systems. We present PathWISE, a five-phase pipeline combining four LLM-based agents with a deterministic depth-first search auditor and a Java compiler critic, transforming these non-computable artefacts into validated, executable HL7 Clinical Quality Language (CQL) libraries deployable as FHIR CDS Hooks services. Purpose-built agents extract flowchart structure into a typed directed graph, perform deterministic path enumeration, conduct a structured semantic audit of every node's computability, generate terminology-constrained CQL definitions verified by the official Java CQL-to-ELM compiler, and produce routing logic covering 100% of enumerated patient journeys. Demonstrated across five UK NHS cancer pathways (colorectal, lung, skin, upper GI, and breast), PathWISE audits up to 183 nodes (182 under the Hybrid configuration), identifies 544 structured governance findings across four issue categories, achieves 100% syntactic compilation success, with UNCOMPUTABLE nodes receiving false placeholders that preserve compilability while surfacing governance gaps for clinical review, and produces zero hallucinated terminology codes for dictionary-covered concepts. Critically, PathWISE confines non-deterministic LLM inference to knowledge extraction while deterministic graph mathematics and a standard compiler underpin every verification step.

</details>


### [151] [DuoGesture: Neuro-Inspired and Biomechanically Informed Dual-Stream Co-Speech Gesture Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26236)
*Ferdinand Paar,Lanmiao Liu,Aslı Özyürek,Serge Thill,Esam Ghaleb*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: DuoGesture提出了一种神经启发且生物力学驱动的双流框架，将共语手势生成分解为语义流和节拍流，通过语义变分信息瓶颈进行随机帧级协调，采用运动接地语义条件替代纯语言词嵌入，并利用惯性节拍先验减少抖动，实验表明优于整体式基线模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有整体式手势模型将词汇驱动的语义手势与韵律对齐的节拍手势混为一谈，限制了语义接地性、语音-运动对齐精度和运动学平滑性。

Method: 提出双流架构：语义流（运动接地语义条件）和节拍流（惯性节拍先验），通过语义变分信息瓶颈（随机帧级门控）协调两者切换。

Result: 客观评估和主观实验均表明DuoGesture优于强整体式基线，组件消融实验证实了语义接地、随机流选择和生物力学正则化的互补作用。

Conclusion: 解耦语义与节拍手势的双流范式结合生物力学约束，能同时提升语义表达力和运动学合理性，为共语手势生成提供了新方向。

Abstract: Co-speech gesture generation requires both semantic expressivity and biomechanically plausible rhythmic motion. Existing holistic gesture models mix lexically grounded semantic gestures with frequent prosody-aligned beat gestures. This limits semantic grounding, speech-motion alignment, and kinematic smoothness. We propose \emph{DuoGesture}, a neuro-inspired and biomechanically informed dual-stream approach that decomposes co-speech gesture synthesis into coupled semantic and beat streams. The two streams are coordinated by a \emph{Semantic Variational Information Bottleneck}, a stochastic frame-level gate that learns when semantic gestures should override rhythmic beat motion. The semantic stream is controlled by \emph{Motion-Grounded Semantic Conditioning}, which replaces purely linguistic word embeddings with motion-language representations to provide motion-aligned semantic priors for long-tailed lexical triggers of gestures. The beat stream is further regularised by an \emph{Inertial Beat Prior}, an anthropometry-weighted arm-chain module that reduces jitter and improves rhythmic consistency without constraining semantic frames. Objective evaluations and subjective experiments show that DuoGesture outperforms strong holistic baselines, while component ablations confirm the complementary roles of semantic grounding, stochastic stream selection, and biomechanical regularisation.

</details>


### [152] [Once-For-All: A Train-Once and Select-Anytime Framework for Multimodal Instruction Tuning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26761)
*Mingkang Dong,Hongyi Cai,Xiwen Lei,Jie Li,Tao Zhang,Muxin Pu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出OFA框架，只需训练一次轻量级数据选择器，即可跨数据集和跨模型复用，无需重新计算。在LLaVA-665K上训练后直接迁移到Vision-Flan-186K，选15%数据达到全量数据98.3%性能，小数据集上甚至超越全量训练10.6%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有数据选择方法依赖特定模型或数据集，当目标模型或候选池变化时需要从头重新计算选择信号，成本高昂且不可复用。

Method: 在冻结的CLIP空间中对多模态指令进行聚类，利用聚类结构生成伪标签，训练轻量级选择器（仅需少量epoch）；选择该选择器最不确信的样本作为最具信息量的数据。选择器仅训练一次即可跨数据集和跨模型规模迁移。

Result: 选15%数据达到全量数据98.3%性能；在Vision-Flan-186K上迁移选择器超越全量训练10.6%；选择器在Qwen2.5-VL-3B和LLaVA-v1.5-7B上均有效，无需按模型重新计算。

Conclusion: 单个可迁移的选择器为高效多模态指令微调提供了可复用的有效方案，实现选择信号与目标模型/数据集的解耦。

Abstract: Multimodal instruction tuning is the de facto recipe for adapting vision language models (VLMs), yet instruction data are highly redundant, making data selection critical for training efficiency. Existing methods derive selection signals from a specific model or dataset, so whenever the target model or candidate pool changes, the criteria must be recomputed from scratch at substantial cost. To address this, we propose OFA, a data selection framework that trains a reusable selector once and applies it to any dataset or model without recomputation. OFA clusters multimodal instructions in a frozen CLIP space, derives pseudo labels from the cluster structure, and trains a lightweight selector for only a few epochs; samples on which this selector is least confident are selected as the most informative. Once trained, the frozen selector transfers directly across datasets and model scales. The selector is trained once on LLaVA-665K and applied both to LLaVA-665K itself and, without any retraining, to the unseen Vision-Flan-186K. Selecting only 15% of the data, OFA achieves 98.3% of full data performance across 10 downstream benchmarks; on the smaller Vision-Flan-186K, the transferred selector surpasses full data training by 10.6%, confirming that the learned signal generalizes to datasets never seen during selector training. The same selected subsets benefit VLMs at both Qwen2.5-VL-3B and LLaVA-v1.5-7B without per model recomputation, decoupling selection from the target model. These results demonstrate that a single, transferable selector provides an effective and reusable solution for efficient multimodal instruction tuning.

</details>


### [153] [SalsaAgent: A multimodal embodied language model for interactive dance generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.29219)
*Payam Jome Yazdian,Zoe Stanley,Angelica Lim*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出SalsaAgent，一种基于大语言模型（LLM）的框架，通过扩展LLM词汇表以处理离散运动、成对关系及音频令牌，并引入令牌到扩散的两阶段流水线，实现生成与人类领舞者及音乐上下文协调的全身萨尔萨舞动作。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 实现社交感知机器人及交互式虚拟代理，使其能够在双人交互中展现非言语的响应性、协调性与同步性，特别是完成与人类领舞者及音乐背景相协调的全身舞蹈动作生成。

Method: 将交互建模为非言语运动令牌传递：扩展LLM词汇表以处理离散全身运动令牌、成对关系令牌及音频令牌；利用自动推导的骨架动力学文本描述进行令牌接地并微调LLM；设计两阶段令牌到扩散流水线以生成高质量连续运动。

Result: 在动作质量、音乐与伙伴协调性、一致的双人空间行为等方面，主观与客观评估均显示出显著优于基线的性能提升。

Conclusion: 基于LLM扩展令牌词汇表并结合两阶段扩散生成的方法，能够有效生成与人类领舞者和音乐上下文协调的全身舞蹈运动，为社交智能代理的交互生成提供了有效范式。

Abstract: Interaction between humanoids involves bidirectional and nonverbal reactivity, coordination and synchrony. Toward socially aware robots and interactive virtual agents, we present SalsaAgent, a language model that generates expressive, full-body salsa dance motions in reaction to a human leader and against a contextual music backdrop. We formulate interaction as nonverbal motion token passing, extending the vocabulary of a large language model (LLM) to process discrete motion tokens, pairwise relation tokens, and audio. Our contributions include new tokens for full-body and motion relations, LLM fine-tuning using automatically derived text descriptions of skeleton dynamics for token grounding, and a two-stage token-to-diffusion pipeline. Subjective and objective evaluations demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach in terms of motion quality, music and partner coordination, and consistent two-person spatial behavior, with significant improvements over baselines.

</details>


### [154] [Clustering Guided Domain-Specific Pretrained Foundation Model for Very High-Resolution Arctic Remote Sensing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.30467)
*Amal S. Perera,Chandi Witharana,Elias Manos,Michael Pimenta,Anna K. Liljedahl*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种面向北极地区的遥感基础模型，通过多样性感知的区域尺度图像筛选和掩码自编码器自监督预训练，在VHSR卫星图像分析中显著优于ImageNet初始化和通用地球观测基础模型Prithvi-EO-2.0，证明了针对特定区域优化预训练数据分布的有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有遥感基础模型多基于通用地球观测数据预训练，缺乏对北极地区高空间分辨率影像的特定适应性，且大规模VHSR数据中存在大量视觉重复或低信息区域，需要一种更高效的数据筛选策略来提升预训练效果。

Method: 利用光谱和采集元数据描述符，通过可扩展的亲和传播聚类工作流从267 TB Vantor VHSR影像中筛选约300万张图像块；采用域自适应的MAE重建目标对ViT-Large编码器进行自监督预训练，生成北极特定的Transformer权重。

Result: 在四个手工标注的北极数据集上，相比ImageNet初始化的ViT-Large基线，前景平均F1分数分别提升至0.87、0.72、0.93和0.87，增幅约5-8个百分点；相比Prithvi-EO-2.0，最小增益为15个百分点以上的平均F1提升。

Conclusion: 在保持架构和MAE目标不变的情况下，优化区域尺度的预训练数据分布即可产生可复用的北极域编码器，域特定的自监督预训练比通用地球观测基础模型能为精细尺度北极制图提供更具迁移性的表征。

Abstract: This study introduces a novel Arctic-focused remote sensing foundation model (RSFM) by combining diversity-aware regional-scale image curation with masked autoencoder (MAE) self-supervised pretraining of a Vision Transformer (ViT) encoder for very-high-spatial-resolution (VHSR) satellite image analysis. Spectral and acquisition-metadata descriptors were used in a scalable affinity-propagation clustering workflow to select approximately 3 million chips from 267 TB of Vantor VHSR imagery This curation strategy was designed to reduce oversampling of visually repetitive or low-information areas while preserving broad scene diversity across the study domain. We pretrained a ViT-Large encoder on the curated corpus using a domain-adapted MAE reconstruction objective, producing Arctic-specific transformer weights for downstream feature mapping. The pretrained encoder was integrated into an existing location-aware detection and segmentation framework and evaluated across four hand-labeled Arctic datasets. Compared to ImageNet-initialized ViT-Large baseline, Arctic MAE pretraining produced consistent improvements in foreground mean F1 scores of 0.87, 0.72, 0.93, and 0.87, for infrastructure, IWP, RTS, and TCNs, with approximately 5-8 percentage increase. The proposed model also outperformed Prithvi-EO-2.0 in all downstream comparisons, with the smallest gain corresponding to at least a 15 percentage improvement mean F1, suggesting that domain-specific self-supervised pretraining on curated Arctic VHSR imagery provides more transferable representations for fine-scale Arctic mapping than a general-purpose Earth observation foundation model. These results demonstrate that optimizing the pretraining data distribution at regional scale, while keeping the architecture and MAE objective fixed, can produce a reusable Arctic-domain encoder for multiple VHSR remote sensing applications.

</details>


### [155] [A Trajectory-Driven Spatio-Temporal Refinement Solution for CVPR 2026 8th UG2+ Challenge Track 3: DOST](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00522)
*Hongzhen Li,Miao Yu,Leilei Cao,Youwei Pan,Yingfang Zhu,Fengjie Zhu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出一种面向大气湍流下动态目标分割的方法，基于SegAnyMo框架，通过数据增强（模拟湍流退化+DAVIS/DOST数据集扩展）和时空后处理模块（去除边界假阳性与噪声，保留小目标及标签一致性），在CVPR 2026 UG2+挑战赛Track 3中获得第二名。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 应对严重大气湍流导致的动态目标分割性能下降问题，现有基线方法在复杂几何畸变下表现不足。

Method: 1）基于SegAnyMo框架；2）数据域自适应：扩展DAVIS与DOST子集，施加模拟湍流退化增强鲁棒性；3）时空后处理模块：去除边界持续假前景与短暂碎片噪声，保留真实小目标并维持帧间标签一致性。

Result: 在UG2+挑战赛DOST赛道取得第二名。

Conclusion: 结合数据域自适应与时空后处理能有效提升湍流场景下动态目标分割性能。

Abstract: In this work, we present our solution for the 8th UG2+ Challenge (CVPR 2026) Track 3: Dynamic Object Segmentation in Turbulence (DOST). Our method is built upon the strong baseline framework Segment Any Motion (SegAnyMo), which provides powerful mask generation and motion tracking capabilities. To further boost the segmentation performance under severe atmospheric distortions, we propose two key improvements. First, we employ a data-centric domain adaptation strategy. We significantly expand our training data by incorporating selected sequences from the DAVIS dataset alongside a subset of the DOST dataset, and apply simulated atmospheric fluctuation degradations to enhance the model's robustness against complex geometric distortions. Second, we introduce a spatio-temporal post-processing module. This refinement step effectively removes persistent boundary-connected false foregrounds and short-lived fragmented noise, while strictly preserving genuine small targets and maintaining original individual labels across frames. With these combined strategies, our proposed method ranks the 2st place in the challenge.

</details>


### [156] [Pause and Think: A Dataset and Benchmark for Video-Grounded Assistive Action Suggestion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00616)
*Shivam Singh,Saptarshi Majumder,Pratik Prabhanjan Brahma,Zicheng Liu,Emad Barsoum*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出 pause-and-think-T 推理训练数据集，通过引导模型在回答前进行结构化推理，使紧凑型 4B 参数模型在视频理解与规划任务上达到与超大模型（235B）相当的性能（58.0% vs 58.9%），并在场景理解上超越 GPT-4o，同时展现出强大的分布外泛化能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视觉语言模型在视频理解中存在 grounded reasoning、时序一致性和上下文感知规划能力不足的问题，亟需提升模型对视觉证据的推理能力以生成更具可操作性的响应。

Method: 构建 pause-and-think-T 训练数据集，引入"暂停-推理-回答"的结构化推理范式，在紧凑的 4B 参数模型上进行微调，并在 pause-and-think-B 基准上评估。

Result: 4B 模型在场景理解和目标规划任务上达到 58.0% 准确率，与 Qwen3-VL-235B（58.9%）几乎持平，参数规模仅为其 1/59；在场景理解上超越 GPT-4o；在 EgoThink 和 TempCompass 上展现出强分布外泛化能力，在 affordance、assistance、attribution、situated reasoning 和时序顺序等维度均有显著提升。

Conclusion: 通过针对性的推理监督训练，紧凑模型能够在不依赖大规模参数扩展的情况下，产出可操作、视觉锚定的指导，并泛化到训练数据之外。

Abstract: Recent Vision-Language Models (VLMs) struggle with grounded reasoning, temporal consistency, and context aware planning in videos. We introduce pause-and-think-T, a reasoning-centric training dataset that encourages models to pause, reason over visual evidence, and produce concise, actionable responses. The dataset promotes structured reasoning prior to answer generation, guiding models toward human-like, scene-grounded assistance. We fine-tune a compact 4B-parameter model and evaluate it on our pause-and-think-B benchmark targeting contextual understanding and goal planning tasks. The model achieves 58.0% accuracy at 59x fewer parameters than Qwen3-VL-235B (58.9%), matching GPT-5.2 on scene understanding and surpassing GPT-4o. Beyond our benchmark, it also shows strong out-of-distribution performance on EgoThink and TempCompass, with substantial gains in affordance, assistance, attribution recognition, situated reasoning, and temporal order, without benchmark-specific training. Our results indicate that targeted reasoning supervision enables compact models to deliver actionable, visually grounded guidance while generalizing beyond training data, without requiring large-scale model expansion.

</details>


### [157] [R^3: Composed Video Retrieval via Reasoning-Guided Recalling and Re-ranking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01113)
*Zixu Li,Yupeng Hu,Zhiheng Fu,Zhiwei Chen,Weili Guan,Liqiang Nie*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出R³方法，通过推理引导的召回和重排序，解决组合视频检索（CoVR-R）挑战。该方法将源视频与编辑指令转化为推理程序，生成目标视频的推理轨迹，并融合检索分数，最后通过重排序验证候选结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 组合视频检索不同于标准视频-文本检索，查询由源视频和编辑指令共同定义。现有强嵌入模型虽然可扩展召回，但难以表达目标侧的状态变化、动作替换等细粒度语义；而逐对多模态排序器直接验证细节但计算代价高。因此需要一种兼顾效率与精度的零样本检索方案。

Method: R³流程包含三阶段：1）推理引导的召回——生成描述编辑后目标视频的推理轨迹，将其与源视频编码为推理增强查询，并通过一致性门控残差规则融合检索分数；2）基组合查询的初步检索；3）重排序——通过直接源-候选对比验证召回结果。

Result: 实验表明R³方法在组合视频检索任务上表现有效，验证了推理引导召回与重排序相结合的策略的优越性。

Conclusion: 将文本编辑指令转化为推理轨迹作为检索信号，结合门控融合与重排序，能够有效提升零样本组合视频检索的性能。

Abstract: The CoVR-R challenge evaluates composed video retrieval, where a system must retrieve a target video from a large gallery given a reference video and a textual edit instruction. This setting is not a standard video-text retrieval problem: the query is defined by both the visual evidence in the source video and the transformation implied by the edit. A strong embedding model can provide scalable candidate recall, but it may under-express target-side consequences such as state changes, action replacement, object preservation, or temporal consistency. A pairwise multimodal reranker can verify such details more directly, but exhaustive reranking over the full gallery is computationally infeasible. We present $\mathbb{R}^3$, a zero-shot composed video retrieval pipeline built around Reasoning-guided Recalling and Reranking. The core idea is to turn the source-edit query into a reasoning-grounded retrieval program rather than treating the edit text as a short caption. First, the model generates a reasoning trace that describes the expected target video after applying the edit. Then the trace is encoded together with the source video as a reasoning-augmented query, and its retrieval score is fused with the base composed query through an agreement-gated residual rule. At last, a re-ranker verifies the recalled candidates with direct source-candidate comparison. Experiments have demonstrated the effectiveness of our method in addressing this challenge. Codes are available on https://github.com/Lee-zixu/R-3.

</details>


### [158] [Hierarchically Decoupled Mixture-of-Experts for Robust Traffic Sign Recognition in Complex Driving Scenarios](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01822)
*Mingxiao Wang,Xiaozhen Qu,Bolin Gao,Tong Wang,Lei He*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出了一种基于层次化解耦异构混合专家（MoE）框架的交通标志检测方法CBDES MoE TSR，通过图像级动态路由机制，从全局共享参数范式转向按需动态表征，在复合交通标志数据集上实现mAP50-95 76.8%，较基线提升2.3%，同时计算开销降低约39.4%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有交通标志检测器大多依赖静态推理和全局共享参数，难以同时适应清晰近景样本与远处小目标、恶劣天气等挑战性场景，单一静态模型无法兼顾多样化和非结构化交通环境下的检测性能。

Method: 提出层次化解耦异构混合专家框架CBDES MoE TSR，构建异构YOLO专家池结合轻量级门控网络，实现图像级动态路由机制；门控模块根据输入图像的语义特征选择性激活最合适的专家模型，从固定参数拟合转向按需动态表征。

Result: 在复合交通标志数据集上，该方法实现mAP50-95为76.8%，较基线方法（74.5%）提升2.3%，同时计算开销降低约39.4%。

Conclusion: 所提方法有效验证了动态路由机制在交通标志检测中的优越性，在检测精度与效率之间取得了显著平衡。

Abstract: Traffic sign detection is a fundamental component of environmental perception in autonomous driving and intelligent transportation systems. However, most existing detectors rely on static inference with globally shared parameters, limiting their ability to adapt to diverse and unstructured traffic scenarios. As a result, a single static model often struggles to simultaneously handle both clear near-range samples and challenging conditions such as distant small targets or adverse weather environments. To address this limitation, we propose CBDES MoE TSR, a hierarchically decoupled heterogeneous mixture-of-experts(MoE) framework for traffic sign recognition. The proposed framework departs from the conventional globally shared parameter paradigm by introducing a heterogeneous You Only Look Once (YOLO) expert pool together with a lightweight gating network, enabling an image-level dynamic routing mechanism. Based on the semantic characteristics of the input image, the gating module selectively activates the most suitable expert model from the expert pool, enabling a shift from fixed parameter fitting to on-demand dynamic representation. This design enhances feature extraction capability for specific scenarios while maintaining controlled inference overhead. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed method achieves a remarkable balance between detection accuracy and efficiency on the composite traffic sign dataset. Specifically, our method attains an mAP50-95 of 76.8%, yielding a 2.3% improvement over the baseline method (74.5%) while simultaneously reducing computational overhead by approximately 39.4%. These findings robustly validate the effectiveness of the proposed approach.

</details>


### [159] [Unified Driving Tokens: Representation- and Geometry-Guided Discrete Tokenizer for Driving World Models and Planning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01935)
*Ziyang Yao,Zeyu Zhu,YunCheng Jiang,Zibin Guo,Huijing Zhao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出一种结合表示引导与几何增强的离散视觉分词器，通过联合监督（特征解码、RGB重建、深度与相对位姿约束）和多码本量化，提升自动驾驶中token的紧凑性、重建保真度和规划性能，在NAVSIM上验证了有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有离散视觉分词器多继承自图像生成任务，仅优化像素重建，导致生成任务与驾驶决策任务之间存在表征鸿沟，缺乏对驾驶决策有用的结构化表示。

Method: 1) 表示引导：在离散瓶颈层对齐冻结的DINO特征空间，通过特征解码学习语义表征；2) 外观保持：使用感知损失和对抗损失进行RGB重建；3) 几何增强：加入相邻帧深度和相对位姿监督；4) 多码本量化：稳定联合训练目标。

Result: 在NAVSIM上，该方法在重建保真度和表示一致性上优于基线，在固定解码器下取得有竞争力的规划性能，在同等设定下生成质量更优。

Conclusion: 通过联合优化特征对齐、几何感知和多码本量化，离散视觉token能够同时兼顾生成质量与驾驶决策需求，弥合了生成与规划之间的表征鸿沟。

Abstract: Discrete visual tokens should provide a compact representation for both token-based world modeling and planning in autonomous driving. However, most tokenizers are inherited from image generation and are optimized mainly for pixel reconstruction, which may leave a gap between what is easy to generate and what is useful to decode for driving decisions. We present a representation-guided and geometry-enhanced tokenizer that learns discrete tokens under joint supervision. The tokenizer aligns its discrete bottleneck with a frozen DINO feature space through feature decoding, while preserving appearance via RGB reconstruction with perceptual and adversarial losses. To inject geometric state-related cues, we add adjacent-frame depth and relative-pose supervision during training and stabilize joint objectives with multi-codebook quantization. We evaluate the same learned tokens with a lightweight planning readout and a GPT-style next-token world model. Experiments on NAVSIM show improved reconstruction fidelity and representation consistency, competitive planning performance under a fixed decoder, and better generative quality under matched settings.

</details>


### [160] [Pixel Cube: Diffusion-based Portrait Video Relighting Through Realistic Lighting Reproduction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02919)
*Yufan Zhang,Yu Ji,Ayo Ajiboye,Rundi Wu,Yu Guo,Changxi Zheng,Jinwei Ye*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出了一种基于扩散模型的动态人像视频重光照方法，利用混合训练数据集（真实拍摄+渲染）和HDR环境图控制，实现具有真实感、时间一致性和身份保持的视频重光照，在照片真实感、光照和谐性和时间一致性上达到SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有动态人像视频重光照方法在真实感、时间一致性和身份保持方面仍有不足，缺乏能够处理复杂面部运动、精细面部特征和大范围光照变化的实用方案。

Method: 1) 构建LED灯光系统用于真实光照模拟和高速视频重光照数据采集；2) 利用预训练视频扩散模型的图像先验，以逐帧HDR环境图为光照控制信号训练生成模型；3) 引入合成背景图像控制相机曝光和色调；4) 采用混合训练集（真实拍摄+渲染）涵盖多样化的外观、面部运动和光照条件。

Result: 在光照真实感、光照和谐性和时间一致性上达到SOTA性能，能忠实保持被摄主体的表情、肤色、皱纹和胡须等精细面部特征，对未见数据（新主体、新运动、新光照）具有良好的泛化能力。

Conclusion: 基于扩散模型的动态人像重光照方法结合混合数据集和HDR环境图控制，能够生成真实感强、时间一致且身份保持的重光照视频，并在实际人像摄影中具有应用潜力。

Abstract: We present a diffusion-based method for relighting dynamic portrait videos with photorealism and temporal consistency. Our method is fueled by a hybrid training dataset that consists of real-captured and rendered dynamic portrait videos with diverse subject appearances, facial motions, head poses, and known lighting conditions. Specifically, we construct an LED-based lighting system for realistic lighting emulation and high-speed video relighting data acquisition. By leveraging the image priors embedded in pre-trained video diffusion models, and using per-frame high dynamic range (HDR) environment map as lighting control, we train a high-performance generative model for realistic and identity-preserving dynamic portrait video relighting. In addition to the environment map control, our model uses a synthesized background image to enable control on the camera's exposure level and color tone. Our model can produce temporally consistent relit portrait video that looks realistic and harmonious under a provided new environment and faithfully preserve the subject's expression and fine facial features, including skin tone, wrinkles, and facial hair. Our model generalizes well to unseen data, in terms of the subject appearance, motion, and lighting condition. We perform extensive experiments on relighting in-the-wild videos with various environment maps and demonstrate practical applications on portrait photography. Results show that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance in photorealism, lighting harmony, and temporal consistency.

</details>


### [161] [Zero-Shot 3D Question Answering via Hierarchical View-to-Token Transportation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.03100)
*Dongsheng Wang,Dawei Su,Hui Huang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出KeyVT层次化方法，在视图和令牌级别进行输入上下文筛选，通过结合像素特征与相机参数评估视图重要性，并利用最优传输框架识别关键令牌，在三个基准上显著优于现有免调优方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 零样本3D场景理解中，多视角2D VLM范式下输入上下文质量至关重要，如何在有限输入预算内保留尽可能多任务相关的3D细节是核心挑战。

Method: 提出KeyVT层次化方法：(1) 视图级：结合像素特征与相机参数，基于语义内容和几何位置评估视图重要性，选择空间一致且任务相关的视图；(2) 令牌级：在最优传输框架下将视图令牌与关键令牌建模为嵌入空间中的两个离散分布，通过最小化OT距离选择代表性令牌覆盖所有视图特征。

Result: 在三个广泛使用的基准上，显著优于现有免调优方法，性能与基于训练的方法相当。

Conclusion: 层次化的视图和令牌级上下文筛选能有效提升零样本3D场景理解性能，最优传输框架可用于建模令牌间的覆盖关系。

Abstract: Recently, zero-shot 3D scene understanding via 2D Vision-Language Models (VLMs) has gained increasing research interest due to their promising spatial reasoning capabilities. Typically, multiple 2D views are sampled from a 3D point cloud and fed into pre-trained VLMs to answer a given question. This paradigm highlights the critical role of input context quality and raises the challenge of retaining as many task-relevant 3D details as possible under a limited input budget. We propose \texttt{KeyVT}, a hierarchical approach for input context collection at both the view and token levels. Specifically, we combine pixel features with camera parameters and assess view importance based on both semantic content and geometric position, resulting in spatially consistent and task-relevant views. Furthermore, we address redundancy among patches across selected views by identifying representative tokens under the optimal transport (OT) framework, where view tokens and key tokens are formulated as two discrete distributions in the embedding space. These key tokens are expected to cover all view features by minimizing the OT distance. We evaluate our framework on three widely used benchmarks, demonstrating significant improvements over existing tuning-free methods and performance comparable to training-based approaches.

</details>


### [162] [Beyond False Stability: High-Noise Drift Gating for Test-Time Adversarial Defenses in Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.03730)
*Hashmat Shadab Malik,Muzammal Naseer,Salman Khan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文发现CLIP视觉表征存在一个从弱噪声到强噪声的“噪声区间转变”：对抗样本在弱噪声下异常稳定（虚假稳定性），但在强噪声下变得比干净样本更不稳定。基于此，提出了一种免训练的漂移门控机制，利用高噪声下的特征漂移作为轻量级门控信号，仅在检测到对抗样不稳定性时才触发现有的测试时防御方法，从而在13个数据集上一致改善了干净-鲁棒权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的测试时随机扰动防御虽然提升了鲁棒性，但往往以牺牲干净准确率为代价，存在不理想的干净-鲁棒权衡。作者试图探索CLIP表征空间中噪声区间的转变，以找到更好的区分对抗样本与干净样本的信号，从而在不影响干净准确率的前提下提升鲁棒性。

Method: 首先通过实验分析发现CLIP表征空间中存在噪声区间转变：弱噪声下对抗样本异常稳定（虚假稳定性），强噪声下对抗样本变得比干净样本更不稳定。据此提出Drift-Gated机制，利用高噪声下的特征漂移作为轻量级门控信号，仅在检测到对抗样不稳定性时触发已有的测试时防御（如counterattack或noise-anchoring），否则保持原始预测。该方法是免训练的即插即用模块。

Result: 在13个数据集上一致改善了干净-鲁棒权衡。在8个细粒度数据集上，干净+对抗平均准确率从65.7%提升至71.4%（counterattack防御）和68.4%提升至73.2%（noise-anchoring防御）；在ImageNet及4个移位变体上，从56.1%提升至66.2%和62.1%提升至67.6%。

Conclusion: CLIP中对抗样本与干净样本在强噪声下的稳定性差异可作为有效的检测信号。所提出的漂移门控机制无需训练即可显著改善干净-鲁棒权衡，且这种噪声区间转变在鲁棒训练后的模型中消失，表明其与非鲁棒CLIP中对抗表征的脆弱局部盆地几何有关。

Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) such as CLIP show strong zero-shot generalization but remain highly vulnerable to adversarial attacks. Adversarial training improves robustness but is computationally expensive, motivating test-time defenses. Recent approaches exploit how CLIP's visual representations respond to stochastic perturbations: aggregating predictions across noisy views, constructing Gaussian noise-averaged anchors and interpolating features toward them, or applying counter-perturbations. These strategies improve robustness but often degrade clean accuracy, yielding an unfavorable clean-robust trade-off. We revisit stochastic test-time defenses and identify an underexplored noise-regime transition in CLIP's representation space. Prior work explored perturbations mainly in the weak-noise regime, where adversarial examples can appear unusually stable (false stability). Our analysis shows this reverses as perturbation strength grows: beyond the weak-noise regime, adversarial representations become markedly more unstable than clean ones, giving a clearer separation signal. The transition is consistent across uniform and Gaussian noise, photometric and geometric transforms, datasets, and diverse attacks. It largely disappears in adversarially trained models, suggesting it is tied to the fragile local-basin geometry of adversarial representations in non-robust CLIP. We propose a training-free, plug-in drift-gated mechanism that uses high-noise feature drift as a lightweight gating signal to trigger existing test-time defenses only when adversarial-like instability is detected. Across 13 datasets it consistently improves the clean-robust trade-off. On eight fine-grained datasets, mean clean+adversarial accuracy rises from 65.7% to 71.4% for counterattack defenses and 68.4% to 73.2% for noise-anchoring; on ImageNet and four shifted variants, from 56.1% to 66.2% and 62.1% to 67.6%.

</details>


### [163] [Dream.exe: Can Video Generation Models Dream Executable Robot Manipulation?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.04811)
*Rui Zhao,Kaiming Yang,Jifeng Zhu,Siyang Chen,Ziqi Wang,Weijia Wu,Kevin Qinghong Lin,Heng Wang,Mike Zheng Shou*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出Dream.exe评估框架，通过将视频生成模型生成的操纵视频转换为机器人轨迹并执行，来检验生成模型对物理世界的理解程度。实验表明，部分模型具备可执行的物理知识，但视觉质量与可执行性之间并无强关联。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视频生成模型虽然能生成视觉上逼真的内容，但缺乏衡量其对物理世界理解程度的定量标准。作者希望通过机器人操纵任务作为可量化的窗口，检验模型是否真正内化了物理规律。

Method: 提出Dream.exe框架，构建从场景图像+任务描述→生成操纵视频→提取机器人轨迹→物理仿真器执行的全流程评估管线，覆盖101个精心设计的操纵任务，分三个物理复杂度层级，从视觉质量、轨迹保真度和执行成功率三个维度进行评估。

Result: 多个模型在物理仿真中取得了可测量的执行成功率，表明互联网规模数据训练出的生成先验已编码了有意义的物理知识。但视觉质量与可执行性之间呈弱相关，视觉指标无法预测模型的物理理解能力。

Conclusion: Dream.exe提供了一个超越传统视觉评估的基准，揭示了生成模型在物理世界理解方面的能力维度，为后续研究提供了新的评估工具和方向。

Abstract: Video generation models have made impressive strides in synthesizing visually compelling content, yet their outputs remain confined to the virtual domain. A natural question follows: how well do these models reflect the physical world when their generated videos leave the screen and enter reality? We propose robotic manipulation as a concrete, measurable window onto this question: if a model has truly internalized physical laws, the motion it depicts should translate into executable robot behavior. We introduce Dream$.$exe, an evaluation framework that operationalizes this criterion through a video-to-execution pipeline. Given a scene image and a task description, Dream$.$exe synthesizes a manipulation video, converts the generated motion into robot trajectories, and executes them in a physics simulator, yielding a grounding signal that purely visual metrics cannot offer. Using this pipeline, we evaluate 8 models spanning frontier closed-source generators, open-source generators, and robot-specific models. Our benchmark covers 101 manually curated manipulation tasks at three levels of physical complexity, measured across visual quality, trajectory fidelity, and execution success. Encouragingly, several models achieve measurable execution success, suggesting that generative priors learned from internet-scale data already encode meaningful physical knowledge. Yet visual quality proves a poor predictor of executability, exposing a dimension of model capability that standard visual evaluations do not capture. Dream$.$exe will be open-sourced at https://github.com/showlab/Dream.exe.

</details>

### [164] [Bio-plausible Neuromorphic Disturbance Observer Based on Emulation Theory: Extended Version](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05189)
*Hongfu Xu,Xiaoyu Guo,Shengbo Wang,Shuo Gao*

Main category: q-bio.NC

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种神经形态扰动观测器与控制框架，利用脉冲定时编码和自适应阈值触发机制，在保持鲁棒性和适应性的同时，将脉冲事件减少至固定阈值情况的42.6%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 受生物神经系统通过稀疏、事件驱动的尖峰信息处理实现鲁棒性和适应性的启发，旨在替代传统连续时间信号表示方法，开发更具生物合理性的控制框架。

Method: 采用积分-发放(IF)神经元动力学从离散尖峰事件构建扰动估计和控制输入，实现内禀的事件驱动更新；借鉴尖峰频率自适应(SFA)机制设计自适应阈值触发机制，实现基于历史依赖的尖峰生成调控。

Result: 在噪声条件下，自适应阈值尖峰方案将脉冲事件数量降低至固定阈值情况的42.6%，同时保持了神经启发的鲁棒性和适应性。

Conclusion: 所提出的神经形态框架有效结合了生物神经系统的脉冲编码与自适应机制，在降低计算开销的同时保持了系统的鲁棒性和适应性，验证了神经形态方法在控制领域的潜力。

Abstract: Biological neural systems achieve remarkable robustness and adaptability in uncertain environments through sparse, event-driven spike-based information processing and adaptive regulation. Inspired by this paradigm, this paper develops a neuromorhpic disturbance observer (NDO) and control framework that replaces conventional continuous-time signal representations with spike-timing encoding. Both disturbance estimates and control inputs are constructed via integrate-and-fire (IF) neuron dynamics from discrete spike events, yielding intrinsically event-driven updates. An adaptive-threshold triggering mechanism is inspired by spike-frequency adaptation (SFA), enabling history-dependent regulation of spike generation. Simulation results demonstrate that the proposed framework achieves neurally inspired robustness and adaptability, while the adaptive-threshold spiking scheme reduces spike events to 42.6% of the fixed-threshold case under noisy conditions.

</details>


### [165] [Ontology-constrained multi-LLM scoring of hypothesis support in the predictive processing literature](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05206)
*Hamed Nejat,Alexander Maier,Jesse Spencer-Smith,André M. Bastos*

Main category: q-bio.NC

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于本地多LLM管道的文献综合方法，通过本体约束的提示工程，将预测编码神经科学领域31篇研究映射到由36个概念、3个假设构成的三维假设空间，实现了可审计的跨研究一致性评分与几何分析。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 跨学科领域（如预测编码神经科学）存在严重碎片化，涉及计算理论、电生理、成像、行为和建模等多种方法，传统元分析缺乏统一的比较空间来综合这些异质性文献。

Method: 构建本地多LLM管道：(1) 手动定义包含36个概念、3个假设（预测抑制、前向误差传播、普遍性）的预测编码术语表；(2) 由10个本地语言模型组成委员会，对31项研究在局部与全局oddball场景下进行与每个术语表因子的一致性/不一致性评分；(3) 进行成对研究一致性分析、跨模型比较和三维假设空间映射；(4) 定义"假设空间温度"作为几何离散度指标。

Result: 部分假设一致性高而另一些较弱，揭示了结构化分歧，尤其在局部与全局oddball范式之间。局部oddball场景下假设空间温度较低（紧凑），全局oddball场景下温度较高（离散）。能估计实验情境间的变化向量。

Conclusion: 本地多LLM委员会能产生可审计的不一致性测量，将异质性文献映射到定量证据空间，为传统元分析缺乏共同比较空间的跨研究假设映射提供了可泛化的框架。

Abstract: Fragmentation is common in interdisciplinary fields with diverse methods and theoretical commitments. Predictive coding neuroscience is a clear example: its literature spans computational theory, electrophysiology, imaging, behavior, and modeling, creating a synthesis problem that conventional meta-analysis cannot easily resolve. Here, we describe a local multi-LLM pipeline for ontology-constrained literature synthesis. The pipeline reads papers, extracts evidence, incorporates figure descriptions, assembles constrained prompts, and validates outputs against an expert glossary. We manually defined a predictive-coding glossary of thirty-six concepts grouped into three hypotheses: predictive suppression, feedforward error propagation, and ubiquity. A council of ten local language models scored 31 studies according to their agreement or disagreement with each glossary factor across local and global oddball contexts. This enabled pairwise study-agreement analysis, cross-model comparison, and three-dimensional hypothesis-space mapping. Agreement was high for some hypotheses but weaker for others, revealing structured disagreement, particularly across local versus global oddball paradigms. We further define hypothesis-space temperature, a geometric dispersion metric measuring how compactly studies occupy the hypothesis space. Temperature was lower for local oddball contexts and higher for global oddball contexts, indicating greater dispersion in the latter. The scoring geometry also allowed us to estimate vectors of change between experimental contexts. These results demonstrate that local multi-LLM councils can produce auditable disagreement measurements that map heterogeneous literatures into quantitative evidence spaces. This framework may generalize to cross-study hypothesis mapping where conventional meta-analysis lacks a common comparison space.

</details>


### [166] [Cross-scale spatially-aware generative modeling of transcriptomic programs underlying neurodegenerative brain organization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05870)
*Krishnakumar Vaithianathan*

Main category: q-bio.NC

TL;DR: 本文提出一种跨尺度的空间感知生成框架，通过变分生成架构结合图空间平滑正则化，学习区域基因表达与皮层退化的潜在生物学程序，在预测阿尔茨海默病皮层退化脆弱性方面达到R²=0.8604、空间相关r=0.9439。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有影像-转录组研究多依赖基因表达与神经影像表型间的相关性分析，难以建模分子组织如何导致神经退行性病变，且对神经退行性疾病区域选择性脆弱性的生物学机制理解尚不完整。

Method: 利用艾伦人脑图谱中910个标志基因在68个皮层区域的转录组特征，结合ADNI数据中皮层厚度测量构建退化脆弱性图谱，采用变分生成架构学习潜在生物学程序，并通过图空间平滑正则化保持皮层组织结构。

Result: 模型对区域神经退行性脆弱性预测的解释方差为0.8604，预测与观测皮层退化剖面间空间相关性r=0.9439 (p<0.001)，学习到的潜在表征揭示了与分布式疾病易感性相关的结构化转录组组织。

Conclusion: 生物约束的生成建模能够桥接微观分子组织与宏观神经退行性病变，为空间感知的生成神经生物学和计算神经科学奠定基础。

Abstract: Neurodegenerative disorders such as Alzheimer's disease exhibit highly organized patterns of regional brain vulnerability, yet the biological mechanisms underlying this spatial selectivity remain incompletely understood. Existing imaging-transcriptomic studies have largely relied on correlation-based analyses between gene expression and neuroimaging phenotypes, limiting their ability to model how molecular organization gives rise to neurodegeneration. Here, we introduce a cross-scale spatially-aware generative framework for modeling transcriptomic programs underlying cortical neurodegeneration. Regional transcriptomic profiles were derived from the Allen Human Brain Atlas using 910 landmark genes across 68 cortical regions. Neurodegenerative vulnerability maps were constructed from ADNI FreeSurfer cortical thickness measurements by computing regional cortical thinning differences between cognitively normal controls (NC = 926) and Alzheimer's disease subjects (AD = 426). A variational generative architecture was used to learn latent biological programs linking regional gene-expression organization to cortical degeneration while incorporating graph-based spatial smoothness regularization to preserve cortical organization. The proposed framework achieved strong prediction of regional neurodegenerative vulnerability, yielding an explained variance of 0.8604 and a significant spatial correlation between predicted and observed cortical degeneration profiles (r = 0.9439, p < 0.001). The learned latent representations revealed structured transcriptomic organization associated with distributed disease susceptibility. These findings demonstrate that biologically constrained generative modeling can bridge microscale molecular organization with macroscale neurodegeneration, providing a foundation for spatially-aware generative neurobiology and computational neuroscience.

</details>


### [167] [Early psychosis shows deviations in scaling behaviour within a critical regime](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.06290)
*Irem Topal,Paola Moreno Ancalmo,Guillermo Montana Valverde,Philipp Homan,Wolfram Hinzen*

Main category: q-bio.NC

TL;DR: 该研究利用现象学重整化群（PRG）、功率谱密度（PSD）和去趋势波动分析（DFA）方法，发现早期精神病患者的大脑静息态fMRI活动并未丧失临界动力学特征，而是在保留标度不变组织的基础上发生了集体动力学的系统性重组。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 先前的精神疾病临界性相关研究在不同观测指标和模态间结果零散，不清楚不同的标度测量是否捕捉到了大规模脑动力学的共同改变。

Method: 结合现象学重整化群（PRG）框架与功率谱密度（PSD）及去趋势波动分析（DFA），分析早期精神病患者与健康对照组的静息态fMRI数据的标度特性。

Result: 健康对照组静息态活动表现出与临界组织一致的非平凡标度行为；早期精神病患者同样保留了标度不变组织，但在多个观测指标上出现标度指数的系统性偏移。

Conclusion: 早期精神病并非简单地丧失临界动力学，而是在保留标度框架内发生了集体动力学的重组；粗粒化方法与时间标度分析的结合为研究精神疾病的大规模脑动力学提供了原则性框架。

Abstract: Accumulating evidence suggests that large-scale brain activity exhibits scale-invariant dynamics consistent with operation in a near-critical regime. Such dynamics have been associated with long-range correlations, efficient information processing, and the emergence of collective organization. While altered criticality-related measures have been reported in psychiatric disorders, previous findings remain fragmented across observables and modalities, making it unclear whether different scaling measures capture a common alteration of large-scale brain dynamics. Here, we investigated scaling properties in resting-state fMRI data from individuals with early psychosis and healthy controls. We combined a phenomenological renormalization group (PRG) framework with power spectral density (PSD) and detrended fluctuation analysis (DFA) to characterize collective dynamics across scales. In healthy controls, resting-state activity exhibited non-trivial scaling behavior consistent with critical-like organization. Early psychosis participants showed the same overall phenomenology of scale-invariant organization, but with systematic shifts in scaling exponents across multiple observables. These findings indicate that early psychosis is not characterized by a simple loss of critical-like dynamics, but rather by a reorganization of collective dynamics within a preserved scaling regime. More broadly, our results suggest that combining coarse-graining approaches with temporal scaling analyses provides a principled framework for studying large-scale brain dynamics in psychiatric disorders.

</details>


### [168] [Intrinsic Computational Functionalism: From Observer-Relative Maps to Observer-Independent Structures](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.06424)
*Shuqin Ma,Ryota Kanai*

Main category: q-bio.NC

TL;DR: 本文提出内在计算功能主义，认为意识相关的计算属性必须是由系统自身物理实现的内在结构决定，而非外部观察者赋予的标签。通过三级识别分解（标签选择、分区选择、粒度选择），论证只有动力学内部粒度选择才能避免计算属性的观察者相对性，从而为意识的计算解释提供观察者独立的基准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 反计算论证表明，外部强加的计算解释不能作为意识的基础，但并未证明所有计算组织都是观察者相对的。本文旨在发展一种内在计算功能主义，明确什么样的计算属性能够避免观察者相对性批评，从而为意识的计算理论提供有效辩护。

Method: 提出两条操作性标准：(C1)系统内在实例化——相关属性无需观察者标记即可说明，且在保持结构的变量重标记下不变；(C2)干预下的因果-动力学组织——属性必须基于状态空间结构，其中变量相互约束，且在干预下表现出反事实响应。通过三级识别分解（标签选择、分区选择、粒度选择）来定位计算属性与意识相关性的层次。

Result: 任何能避免观察者相对性批评的计算属性必须通过第三级（动力学内部粒度选择）来识别，并受经验约束的第二级（分区选择）限制。语法即非语义论证、地图制作者论证以及生物自然主义批评中关于观察者相对性的部分，仅对定位于第一级（标签选择）的观点构成威胁；在区分三级的框架下，内在计算功能主义得以幸存。

Conclusion: 内在计算功能主义为意识的计算理论提供了观察者独立的基准，通过三级识别框架澄清了计算属性与意识之间的构成关系，为回应反计算论证开辟了理论空间。

Abstract: Anti-computational arguments show that externally imposed computational interpretations cannot ground consciousness, but they do not establish that all computational organisations are observer-relative. We develop intrinsic computational functionalism: the view that, if consciousness is computationally constituted, it depends on physically realised computational structures the system has in virtue of itself rather than on labels imposed by an external interpreter. Two criteria operationalise this view. (C1) System-intrinsic instantiation: the relevant property must be specifiable without an observer's labelling, and invariant under structure-preserving relabellings of the system's variables. (C2) Causal-dynamical organisation under intervention: the property must be grounded in a state-space structure whose variables mutually constrain one another, and whose organisation is exhibited in counterfactual response under intervention. Together these criteria specify what any candidate computational account must satisfy to remain observer-independent, without selecting which intrinsic structures bear on experience. The argumentative core is a three-tier decomposition of identification work: interpreter-relative label selection (tier i), theoretically constrained partition selection (tier ii), and dynamics-internal grain selection (tier iii). We argue that any computational property capable of avoiding the observer-relativity objection must be identified, if at all, through tier (iii) dynamics-internal grain selection, conditional on empirically disciplined tier (ii) choices. Syntax-is-not-semantics arguments, mapmaker arguments, and the observer-relativity component of biological-naturalist objections succeed against views that locate the consciousness-relevant property at tier (i); once the tiers are distinguished, intrinsic computational functionalism survives.

</details>


### [169] [Dynamical incompatibilities in paced finger tapping experiments](https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.23661)
*Ariel D. Silva,Claudia R. González,Rodrigo Laje*

Main category: q-bio.NC

TL;DR: 敲击同步实验中对步进变化和相位偏移两种周期扰动的反应，在分开实验时动态不相容，但混合呈现时则相容，表明单一动力系统可通过时间背景校准解释所有扰动类型，挑战了传统分立的相位与周期校正模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 解决感觉运动同步研究中关于步进变化和相位偏移两种常见周期扰动导致不同反应时序这一长期矛盾，探究其背后的统一机制。

Method: 实验上分别记录和混合呈现两种扰动条件下的敲击反应，理论上检验其是否可被单一动力系统描述，并考察时间背景对系统校准的影响。

Result: 分开实验中两种扰动反应动态不相容，无法用单一动力系统描述；而混合随机呈现时反应变得相容，可被同一机制解释。

Conclusion: 单一动力系统足以表征所有类型、符号和大小的扰动反应，但需通过时间背景进行校准；挑战了传统观点中针对不同扰动类型分别激活相位和周期校正过程的假设。

Abstract: Paced finger-tapping tasks are used to probe the error correction mechanism underlying sensorimotor synchronization. Despite their century-long history, fundamental contradictions persist in the literature. One such contradiction arises when comparing the two most common types of period perturbation: step change and phase shift. The stimulus sequence is exactly the same up to and including the (unexpected) perturbed stimulus. Why then would the timing of the next response be different between perturbation types, as observed? We show, both experimentally and theoretically, that responses to both types of perturbation are dynamically incompatible when recorded in separate experiments; that is, they cannot be described by a single underlying dynamical system due to the build-up of different temporal contexts. In contrast, when both types of perturbation are presented randomly within the same experiment, the responses become compatible and can be explained by a single mechanism. We conclude that a single underlying dynamical system can represent the response to all perturbation types, signs, and sizes, which is nevertheless calibrated by temporal context. Our results challenge the established idea of phase and period correction processes that are separately activated for different perturbation types.

</details>


### [170] [Contextual Role Modulates Object Representational Geometry in the Human Brain](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.23111)
*Julien Dirani,Shankar Chawla,Leila Wehbe,Bradford Z. Mahon*

Main category: q-bio.NC

TL;DR: 论文通过fMRI研究揭示了人脑在自然场景中根据物体扮演的上下文角色（被动场景元素 vs. 行动目标）动态重塑其神经表征：目标物体激活顶叶动作网络并按动作 affordance 组织，被动物体激活枕颞视觉网络并按语义维度组织，而视觉表征结构保持不变。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究同一物体在不同上下文角色（被动场景元素 vs. 目标导向行动的目标）下，其神经表征如何动态重新映射，以理解大脑如何在不变性和灵活性之间取得平衡。

Method: 使用功能性磁共振成像（fMRI）技术，在被试观看自然主义电影片段时，分析同一物体作为被动场景元素和作为行动目标时的神经表征模式，比较不同脑区的表征几何结构。

Result: 行动目标激活以缘上回和中央后回为中心的顶叶动作网络，并按动作 affordance 和手部姿势 affordance 维度组织；被动物体激活分布式枕颞视觉网络，并按语义维度组织。视觉表征结构在两种上下文中保持不变。

Conclusion: 物体表征在自然场景中会根据上下文角色的实时变化进行神经重映射，灵活性和不变性在同一表征系统的不同层级运作。

Abstract: The human brain represents objects in a way that is both invariant across instances and flexible enough to support different contexts and tasks. Yet it remains unknown how object representations are dynamically remapped as the same object shifts across contextual roles. Using fMRI during naturalistic movie viewing we investigated how the same objects are represented when they are passive scene elements versus targets of goal-directed actions. Action targets engaged a parietal action network centered in the supramarginal and postcentral gyri, while passive objects recruited a distributed occipito-temporal network involved in visual object recognition. Within context-selective networks, representational geometry showed a double dissociation: target objects were organized by action affordance and hand posture affordance dimensions, while passive objects aligned with semantic dimensions. Visual representational structure was invariant to context. Outside these networks, representational content retained invariance, indicating that flexibility and invariance operate at different levels of the same representational system. These findings demonstrate neural remapping of object representations depending on moment-to-moment changes in contextual roles during a naturalistic scene.

</details>

### [171] [Annotation of Positive vs Negative User Interactions for Social Sign Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.06425)
*Biancamaria Bombino,Chiara Boldrini,Andrea Passarella,Marco Conti*

Main category: cs.SI

TL;DR: 本文提出利用大语言模型（LLM）在零样本设置下识别交互层面的关系信号（个人赞美和个人攻击），以替代传统基于情感分析推断社交关系符号的方法。在四个模型和三种提示设计上的实验表明，零样本LLM在攻击检测上稳健，在赞美检测上较敏感，为关系标注建立了实用基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法依赖情感分析标记个体交互，但情感分析捕获的是讨论内容的效价而非关系交换本身的性质，这种混淆可能导致系统性误分类。因此需要一种能直接识别关系信号（如个人赞美和攻击）的方法来更准确地推断社交关系符号。

Method: 利用LLM在零样本设置下识别交互层面的关系信号（个人赞美和个人攻击），作为正向和负向社会关系的更直接指标。评估了四种模型（Qwen2.5:7b、Gemma2:9b、GPT-4o、GPT-5.4-mini）在三种复杂度递增的提示设计下，对两个人工标注数据集（约298和340条文本）的性能。

Result: 零样本LLM在两项任务上均实现了良好的分类性能，无需任务特定训练数据。攻击检测对提示设计和模型选择具有稳健性，而赞美检测对两者更敏感，反映了正向关系手势的更大主观性。

Conclusion: 零样本LLM能够有效识别关系信号，为关系标注建立实用基线，为将基于LLM的关系标注整合到符号预测流程中奠定了基础。

Abstract: Inferring the sign of social relationships from online interactions is a fundamental challenge in social network analysis. Existing approaches typically rely on sentiment analysis to label individual interactions as positive or negative, then aggregate these labels to assign a sign to the relationship. However, sentiment analysis captures the valence of the content being discussed rather than the nature of the relational exchange itself, a conflation that can lead to systematic misclassification. In this paper, we propose a methodology that addresses this limitation by leveraging Large Language Models (LLMs) in a zero-shot setting to identify interaction-level relational signals (specifically, personal praise and personal attacks directed at the interlocutor) as more direct indicators of positive and negative social ties. We evaluate four models spanning open-weight and proprietary architectures (Qwen2.5:7b, Gemma2:9b, GPT-4o, GPT-5.4-mini) across three prompt designs of increasing complexity, on two human-annotated datasets of approximately 298 and 340 texts respectively. Results show that zero-shot LLMs achieve good classification performance on both tasks without any task-specific training data, establishing a practical baseline for relational annotation. Performance differs across tasks: attack detection is robust to prompt design and model choice, while praise detection is more sensitive to both, reflecting the greater subjectivity of positive relational gestures. These findings lay the groundwork for integrating LLM-based relational annotation into sign prediction pipelines.

</details>


### [172] [Federating Governance: How Community Rules Scale with Mastodon Instances](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05069)
*Rasika Muralidharan,Yong-Yeol Ahn,Bao Tran Truong*

Main category: cs.SI

TL;DR: 本研究分析了Mastodon实例中社区规则随规模增长的变化，发现规则核心关注点（如骚扰、仇恨言论等）在不同规模实例中高度一致，但大型实例的规则更广泛、主题更多样化，可读性和语言多样性却更低。内部规模压力比外部联邦交互对治理的影响更大，且这种扩展模式与Reddit等中心化平台相似，表明社区规模对自治存在跨平台的根本性约束。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 去中心化社交媒体平台（如Mastodon、Bluesky）在规模扩大时面临自我治理和内容审核的挑战，但主要由志愿者驱动的社区缺乏关于规则和审核实践如何随增长演变的正式指导，本研究旨在填补这一空白。

Method: 通过分析不同规模Mastodon实例的社区规则，对规则进行分类以识别关键治理优先级，并研究规则形式化程度与社区规模、外部联邦交互之间的关系。

Result: 不同规模实例的治理优先级高度一致，均以问题内容（骚扰、仇恨言论、非法内容）为核心；大型实例规则更广泛、主题更多样，但可读性和语言多样性更低；社区规模是规则发展的强预测因子，外部联邦交互影响有限。

Conclusion: 内部规模压力是去中心化社交媒体治理的主导因素，而非网络层面的动态；社区规模对自我治理的约束具有跨平台架构的普遍性。

Abstract: The rise of decentralized social media platforms like Mastodon and Bluesky highlights the challenge of scaling self-governance and moderation. As communities grow, they face new issues that demand increasingly complex governance structures. However, as moderation is mainly volunteer-driven, there is limited formal guidance on how community rules and moderation practices should evolve with growth. This study investigates how moderation scale with Mastodon instances by analyzing community rules across servers of varying sizes. We categorize these rules to identify key governance priorities and find that these priorities are remarkably consistent across instance sizes: rules addressing problematic content, such as harassment, hate speech, and illegal content, dominate regardless of scale. While smaller communities focus on narrower sets of topics, larger servers maintain a more balanced coverage of a broad range of topics. Our analysis of rule formalization reveals that community size strongly predicts rule development. As instances grow, their rules become more extensive and topically diverse, but also exhibit lower readability and linguistic diversity. In contrast, external federation interactions have a limited role, mainly associated with a broader scope of rules without substantially affecting their diversity or form. These findings highlight the relative influence of internal versus external factors, suggesting that local scaling pressures outweigh network-level dynamics in decentralized social media governance. The scaling pattern observed on Mastodon resemble those previously identified on centralized platforms such as Reddit, suggesting that community size imposes fundamental constraints on self-governance that transcend platform architectures

</details>

### [173] [OLIVE: Online Low-Rank Incremental Learning for Efficient Adaptive Exoskeletons](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05234)
*Dong Liu,Yanxuan Yu,Ben Lengerich,Tony Geng,Ying Nian Wu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出OLIVE框架，一种参数高效的在线适应性外骨骼控制框架，通过低秩残差分解、奖励塑造策略梯度和动态秩调度器，实现外骨骼在外界环境中的持续个性化自适应控制，在步态平滑度、努力减少和运动稳定性上分别比最强基线提升13、22和15个百分点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有外骨骼控制器依赖静态步态策略，无法适应动态真实环境或个体用户特征，亟需一种能在线持续个性化的高效自适应控制框架。

Method: 将控制策略的自适应组件分解为低秩残差形式ΔW=AB^T（r≪min(d,k)），将在线更新成本从O(dk)降至O(r(d+k))；采用基于奖励塑造的策略梯度，仅靠本体传感器反馈（EMG、IMU、振动）更新参数；设计门控机制根据上下文状态调节个性化强度；引入动态秩调度器根据地形的复杂度调整更新维度（平地低秩、复杂地形高秩）。

Result: 在可穿戴平台上，OLIVE在步态平滑度、努力减少和运动稳定性上分别比最强基线提升13、22和15个百分点，约1,800步收敛，端到端延迟7.4ms。

Conclusion: OLIVE通过低秩在线增量学习实现了高效、稳定且可泛化的外骨骼个性化控制，在多种活动（平地行走、楼梯、斜坡、不平坦地形）上均表现鲁棒。

Abstract: Wearable exoskeleton systems hold promise for restoring mobility in individuals with physical impairments, yet most existing controllers rely on static gait policies that lack the ability to adapt to dynamic real-world environments or individual user characteristics. We present \olive (\underline{O}nline \underline{L}ow-rank \underline{I}ncremental Learning for Efficient Adapti\underline{ve} Exoskeletons), a parameter-efficient online adaptation framework that continuously personalizes exoskeleton control during deployment. \olive decomposes the adaptive component of the control policy into a low-rank residual form~$\dW = \At\Bt^\top$ with rank~$r!\ll!\min(d,k)$, reducing online update cost from $\mathcal{O}(dk)$ to $\mathcal{O}(r(d{+}k))$ while preserving the stability of a pretrained base controller~$\Wz$. Parameters are updated via a reward-shaped policy gradient driven purely by on-body sensor feedback (EMG, IMU, vibration), eliminating dependence on offline reference trajectories. A gating mechanism modulates the strength of personalization based on contextual state, and a dynamic rank scheduler adapts the update dimensionality to terrain complexity -- allocating minimal capacity on simple flat terrain and expanding to higher-rank updates on demanding uneven surfaces -- enabling robust performance across diverse activities: flat walking, stair navigation, slopes, and uneven terrain. Experiments on the wearable platform demonstrate that \olive achieves +13, +22, and +15 percentage-point improvements in gait smoothness, effort reduction, and motion stability over the strongest baseline, converging within $\sim$1{,}800 walking steps at 7.4,ms end-to-end latency. Our code implementation is available at https://github.com/FastLM/OLIVE.

</details>


### [174] [A New Quaternion-Joint Cable-Driven Redundant Manipulator Configuration and its Control Through FABRIK and Residual Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05236)
*Tanapath Pornthisan,Thanapat Kemthong,Thanyapisit Kangsathien,Pasut Aranchaiya,Paulo Garcia,Viboon Sangveraphunsiri*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于四元数关节的4段8关节电缆驱动冗余机械臂，并采用残差强化学习进行控制。相比现有配置，该机械臂工作空间更大、硬件成本更低，且残差强化学习在位置和姿态精度上比FABRIK算法提升三个数量级。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 工业领域亟需能够在高度阻塞工作空间中穿越任意空间路径的机械臂。四元数关节虽能减少每自由度所需电机数量以实现更紧凑的设计，但其运动学模型复杂，给构型先验决策带来挑战，同时增加控制系统计算负担，且非线性放大了制造误差导致的理想设计与物理实物之间的偏差。

Method: 提出了一种4段、8关节的新型机械臂构型；采用残差强化学习（Residual Reinforcement Learning）进行控制，并与FABRIK算法进行对比。

Result: 该4段8关节构型在更低硬件成本下实现了比现有构型更广泛的工作空间；残差强化学习在位置和姿态精度上比FABRIK算法高出三个数量级，实现了对该新型机械臂的精确控制，且控制实现更简单。

Conclusion: 该构型和残差强化学习方法为这类机械臂的设计提供了新工具，适用于新型系统的开发及相应控制系统的设计。

Abstract: Robotic arms capable of traversing arbitrary spatial paths, especially in highly obstructed workspaces, are highly desired across several industries. Quaternion-joints have recently empowered a specific class of robotic arms -- cable-driven redundant manipulators -- beyond its prior capabilities. Specifically, quaternion-joints reduce the number of required motors per degree of freedom, paving the way for more compact solutions.An ongoing challenge is that the complexity of the kinematic model of quaternion joints challenges a priori decisions on manipulator configurations and imposes higher computational demands on the control system and its non-linearities amplify all discrepancies between design and physical artifact arising from fabrication imprecision. Here we show a that a 4-segment, 8-joint manipulator can achieve a broader workspace than extant configurations, at lower hardware cost, and that Residual Reinforcement Learning outperforms extant state-of-the-art methods -- specifically, the FABRIK algorithm -- on the control of such manipulator. Our results show that this configuration is more workspace-effective than prior designs, and that Residual Reinforcement Learning outperforms FABRIK by three orders of magnitude on positional and orientational accuracy, effecting precise control of the novel 4-segment, 8-joint manipulator. Additionally, the control implementation is simpler: we describe the complete FABRIK process for control and corresponding learning implementation. Our methodology is applicable to the design of new systems, providing designers with further tools for the development of this class of manipulators and corresponding control systems for novel configurations.

</details>


### [175] [Inverse Manipulation through Symbolic Planning and Residual Operator Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05248)
*Yigit Yildirim,Giuseppe Rauso,Riccardo Caccavale,Alberto Finzi*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出了一种混合框架，通过从演示中自动提取STRIPS-like操作符并构建逆操作目标，结合符号任务规划与残差强化学习，将近似符号逆操作转化为物理上可行的逆操作技能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器人逆操作任务不能仅通过反转符号状态转移或回放运动轨迹来实现，因为连续交互动力学下符号逆规划无法完全恢复正向执行的效果。

Method: 1) 从演示中通过软几何谓词自动提取STRIPS-like操作符；2) 为每个操作符构建逆恢复目标（保持前提条件、恢复删除效果、否定添加效果）；3) 任务规划器尝试用现有动作原语满足目标；4) 未解决的符号谓词引发残差操作符学习问题，通过强化学习（SAC）解决。

Result: 在ManiSkill3 PushCube任务中，符号逆操作执行粗略的拾取-放置恢复，残差SAC策略细化立方体位姿以满足剩余逆谓词，验证了谓词导出的残差控制能将近似符号逆操作转化为物理上可行的逆技能。

Conclusion: 符号逆操作与残差强化学习的混合框架能够有效弥合符号规划与连续物理执行之间的鸿沟，实现机器人操作任务的精确逆操作。

Abstract: Inverting a robotic task requires more than reversing symbolic state transitions or rewinding motor trajectories. In robot manipulation tasks, symbolic inverse plans often fail to fully restore the effects of forward executions under continuous interaction dynamics. We present a hybrid framework for inverse manipulation that derives inverse-skill objectives from STRIPS-like operators automatically extracted from demonstrations through soft geometric predicates. For each extracted operator, we construct an inverse restoration objective that preserves preconditions, restores delete effects, and negates add effects. A task planner first attempts to satisfy this objective using available action primitives. Unresolved symbolic predicates then induce a residual operator learning problem solved through Reinforcement Learning (RL). We evaluate the framework on the ManiSkill3 PushCube task. For a forward pushing skill, the symbolic inverse performs a coarse pick-and-place restoration, while a residual Soft Actor-Critic policy refines the cube pose to satisfy the remaining inverse predicates. Our results show that predicate-derived residual control can turn an approximate symbolic inverse into a physically grounded inverse skill.

</details>


### [176] [Efficient Computation of Distance Functions for Navigation Vector Fields in Lie Groups](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05372)
*Vinicius M. Gonçalves,João Baião,Felipe Bartelt,Douglas G. Macharet,Gustavo M. Freitas,Héctor Azpúrua,Luciano C. A. Pimenta*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出一种高效计算点与G-多项式曲线（李群上推广的多项式曲线）间距离的方法，通过将问题简化为少量多项式求根计算，显著降低了计算时间并保持精度，在SE(3)群上给出实用公式，并在机器人操作臂上实验验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于向量场的机器人控制方法需要反复计算机器人配置与曲线间的距离及最近点，当该方法推广到李群时，这种计算在嵌入式平台的高频控制下变得昂贵。现有优化方法计算开销大，需要更高效的替代方案。

Method: 利用G-多项式曲线的结构特性，将距离计算问题简化为少量多项式根求解问题，避免了反复优化计算。针对SE(3)群给出了具体公式，并开发了开源计算包。

Result: 仿真结果表明，与现有基于优化的方法相比，该方法在保持精度的同时显著降低了计算时间；在机器人操作臂上进行了实验验证。

Conclusion: 该方法为李群上的向量场路径跟踪提供了一种高效、可部署于嵌入式平台的距离计算方案，且已以开源软件包形式发布。

Abstract: Vector-field-based methods are widely used for robot control and are often applied to the path-tracking problem. Some vector field approaches require repeatedly computing the distance between the robot configuration and the curve, as well as the corresponding closest point. Recently, vector fields have been extended to Lie Groups. In this case, this computation can be expensive, especially when performed at high control frequencies on embedded platforms. This paper proposes a method for efficiently computing the distance between a point and a curve represented as what is called a G-polynomial curve, which is a curve representation that generalizes polynomial curves to matrix Lie groups. The proposed approach exploits the structure of these curves to reduce the problem to a small number of polynomial root-finding computations. Simulation results show that the method significantly reduces computation time while maintaining accuracy compared to existing optimization-based approaches. Practical formulas are also provided for the case of the group SE(3), and the method is validated experimentally on a robotic manipulator. The methodology is implemented in a computational package, available online.

</details>


### [177] [VASO: Formally Verifiable Self-Evolving Skills for Physical AI Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05395)
*Yunhao Yang,Neel P. Bhatt,Kevin Wang,Samuel Tetteh,Zhangyang Wang,Ufuk Topcu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: VASO是一个将形式化验证与自演化相结合的框架，通过模型检查器过滤不满足时序规范的LLM生成机器人技能合约，并将反例轨迹转化为文本梯度来更新技能合约，在无需微调基础模型权重的情况下，在Jackal和PX4四旋翼任务上达到97.2%的形式规范合规率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有技能演化循环依赖执行反馈、单元测试、环境奖励或LLM自我批判等信号，这些信号仅提供"痕迹级"证据，只能证明技能在采样执行上有效，而无法保证技能诱导的计划在未经测试的条件下满足时序安全契约。

Method: VASO将每个技能表示为带有双接口的语义合约：形式接口将机器人状态、观测和控制命令与逻辑命题对齐以进行模型检查，规划器接口引导可执行行为生成。模型检查器先过滤逻辑不一致的技能合约，再验证技能诱导的计划是否满足全局和局部时序规范。验证失败时，将反例轨迹翻译为文本梯度来更新可复用技能合约，保持基础模型权重冻结。

Result: 在Clearpath Jackal和PX4四旋翼任务上，VASO在不到100个优化样本内达到97.2%形式规范合规率，优于执行反馈、提示优化和微调基线。

Conclusion: VASO是首个将形式化验证与LLM生成技能自演化闭环连接起来的框架，使形式化反例成为可复用机器人技能合约的优化反馈，而非仅用于验证一次性计划、调优规划器提示或微调模型权重。

Abstract: Reusable robot skills are becoming the basic units through which embodied agents turn open-ended instructions into long-horizon physical behavior. We argue that, while foundation models have collapsed the cost of creating these skills, the cost of trusting them has not. Existing skill-evolution loops refine skills through execution feedback, unit tests, environment reward, or LLM self-critique, but these signals provide only trace-level evidence: they show that a skill worked on sampled executions, not that skill-induced plans satisfy temporal safety contracts under untested conditions. We introduce VASO, a framework for verification-guided self-evolution of LLM-generated robot skill contracts. In VASO, each skill is represented as a semantic contract with two coupled interfaces: a formal interface that aligns robot states, observations, and control commands with logical propositions for model checking, and a planner-facing interface that guides executable behavior generation. A model checker first filters logically inconsistent skill contracts, then verifies plans induced by the skill against global and local temporal specifications. When verification fails, VASO translates the counterexample trace into a textual gradient that updates the reusable skill contract while keeping foundation-model weights frozen. On Clearpath Jackal and PX4 quadcopter tasks, VASO reaches 97.2% formal-specification compliance using fewer than 100 optimization samples, outperforming execution-feedback, prompt-optimization, and fine-tuning baselines. To our knowledge, VASO is the first framework that closes the loop between formal verification and self-evolving LLM-generated skills for physical AI agents: formal counterexamples become optimization feedback for reusable robot skill contracts, rather than merely verifying one-off plans, tuning planner prompts, or fine-tuning model weights.

</details>


### [178] [MoDex: A Diffusion Policy for Sequential Multi-Object Dexterous Grasping](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05407)
*Haofei Lu,Hongjia Liu,Yifei Dong,Florian T. Pokorny,Jens Lundell,Danica Kragic*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: MoDex是一种基于扩散策略的灵巧手多物体连续抓取方法，通过反对空间条件让手部仅用部分自由度抓取当前物体，保留剩余自由度用于后续抓取，采用模仿学习+强化学习两阶段训练，在仿真和真实实验中均优于基线方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有灵巧手抓取方法通常将所有自由度用于抓取单一物体，未能充分利用手部灵巧性，且无法在不释放已抓取物体的情况下依次抓取多个物体。

Method: 提出MoDex，一种基于扩散策略的方法，以反对空间和点云为条件，直接从观测预测下一个抓取位姿。反对空间条件指定参与当前抓取的手指，使手部仅使用部分自由度，保留其余自由度用于后续抓取。训练采用两阶段策略：先通过模仿学习在专家演示上预训练，再通过强化学习微调以提升成功率。

Result: 在MuJoCo仿真和真实硬件平台上，MoDex均优于基线方法：仿真中成功率提升2.92-17.92%，真实实验中提升6.67-17.78%。

Conclusion: MoDex通过反对空间条件控制手指参与度配合两阶段训练策略，有效实现了灵巧手的多物体连续抓取，具备良好的仿真到真实迁移能力。

Abstract: This work addresses sequentially grasping multiple objects with a single dexterous hand without releasing those already held. Most dexterous grasping methods commit all of the hand's degrees of freedom to a single object, underutilizing its dexterity and leaving no redundancy for subsequent grasps. The proposed solution, MoDex, is a diffusion policy that predicts the next gripper pose directly from observations, conditioned on an opposition space and point cloud. The opposition space condition specifies which fingers participate in the current grasp, enabling the gripper to use only a subset of its available degrees of freedom while reserving the remaining degrees of freedom for subsequent grasps. To facilitate sim-to-real transfer, MoDex is trained in two stages: first through imitation learning on expert demonstrations, and subsequently through reinforcement learning fine-tuning, which consistently improves success rates over the pre-trained policy. We evaluate MoDex in simulation on a MuJoCo-based Franka Emika Panda robot equipped with an Allegro Hand and on the corresponding real-world hardware platform. Across both simulation and real-world experiments, MoDex achieves higher success rates than the evaluated learning-based baselines, improving performance by 2.92-17.92% and 6.67-17.78%, respectively. Project page: https://modex2026.github.io/.

</details>


### [179] [Learning from Demonstrations over Riemannian Manifolds using Neural ODEs: An Extended Abstract](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05422)
*Diana Cuervo Espinosa,Mahathi Anand,Angela P. Schoellig*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出利用神经常微分方程在黎曼流形上数值估计测地线，以实现机器人位姿（位置与方向）的示教学习，避免了传统方法的高计算开销。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有示教学习（LfD）通常在欧氏空间中进行，但机器人状态（如方向）天然存在于弯曲空间（流形）上，欧氏假设无法准确刻画机器人运动的自然性和复杂性。

Method: 在黎曼流形上编码位置和方向数据，通过神经常微分方程（Neural ODEs）数值估计测地线，再将测地线解码回原始任务空间输出给机器人执行。

Result: 通过仿真实验展示了所提框架的初步效果，并与其它测地线计算方法进行了对比。

Conclusion: 所提方法能够高效地在黎曼流形上生成自然的运动轨迹，且计算开销较低，同时指出了未来的挑战与研究方向。

Abstract: Learning from demonstratins (LfD) is usually performed over Euclidean spaces, while the robot state, e.g. orientation, naturally evolves over curved spaces. Therefore, to ensure natural, complex motion generation, we investigate learning from demonstrations over Riemannian manifolds that are capable of encoding both position and orientation data. Here, geodesic paths provide for natural motion between two arbitrary points within the manifold. We propose to numerically estimate geodesics via neural ordinary differential equations, mitigating large computational overhead of existing approaches. Finally, these geodesics can be decoded back into the original task space before deploying on the robot. In this extended abstract, we discuss the architecture of our framework, provide some initial insights from our simulation experiments, including comparison to other geodesic computation mechanisms, and discuss the challenges and prospects for future work.

</details>


### [180] [Uncertainty-Aware Adaptive Sensor Fusion for Autonomous Navigation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05437)
*Simegnew Yihunie Alaba,Yuichi Motai*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出一种混合深度学习框架结合无迹卡尔曼滤波(UKF)，用于提升视觉-惯性里程计(VIO)的位姿估计精度。模型采用Vision Transformer(ViT)处理IMU时序数据、多尺度CNN(MCNN)学习视觉光流特征，并通过自适应传感器融合模块动态加权。提出不确定性感知损失函数，在KITTI数据集上ATE和RPE显著优于基线，以155 FPS在A100 GPU上高效运行。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有VIO方法在噪声、不完整或不可靠传感器输入下鲁棒性不足，且难以有效融合异构传感器特征并量化不确定性，导致复杂环境中位姿估计精度下降。

Method: 1) 使用Vision Transformer(ViT)从IMU数据中捕获时序依赖；2) 采用多尺度CNN(MCNN)从视觉数据学习光流运动线索；3) 设计自适应传感器融合模块，基于估计不确定性动态加权IMU与视觉特征；4) 提出不确定性感知损失函数，将预测不确定性显式融入学习过程。

Result: 在KITTI数据集上，ATE和RPE指标显著超越基线方法；模型在NVIDIA A100 GPU上达到155 FPS，兼顾高精度与计算效率。

Conclusion: 该混合方法通过不确定性驱动的自适应融合与损失设计，有效提升了VIO在挑战环境下的鲁棒性与精度，且轻量化部署适用于资源受限的自主系统。

Abstract: This work introduces a hybrid deep learning approach integrated with an Unscented Kalman Filter (UKF) to enhance pose estimation accuracy in Visual-Inertial Odometry (VIO) for autonomous navigation. The proposed model employs a Vision Transformer (ViT) network to effectively capture temporal dependencies from inertial measurement unit (IMU) data and utilizes a Multiscale Convolutional Neural Network (MCNN) to learn optical flow-based motion cues from visual data.
